item.title: Pender Co. Republican leaders clash over mailer that endorsed primary candidates
item.description: Many Pender County residents received an advertisement in the mail this week claiming it was paid for by the Pender County Republic Party, though the county GOP said that isn’t the case. The GOP said this piece of mail is misleading voters.

item.title: Novant Health doctor urges colon cancer screenings after James Van Der Beek death
item.description: Medical experts at Novant Health report colon cancer is the second leading cause of death in the U.S. and it is the most common cancer in the country.

item.title: Pender County Schools board holds emergency meeting after alleged booster club embezzlement
item.description: The Pender County Schools Board of Education held an emergency meeting on Thursday after a Topsail High Boosters treasurer was arrested for alleged embezzlement.

item.title: Locals all around Wilmington remembers James Van Der Beek
item.description: People all around Wilmington remember James Van Der Beek

item.title: Wrightsville Beach announces Parking Rate Reductions and New Real-Time Parking Data Initiative
item.description: The Town of Wrightsville Beach has approved several enhancements to its paid parking program. The changes are being made to improve accessibility and enhance visitor experience.

item.title: CFCC English Department to host Alumna and Author S.C. Porter for reading and discussion
item.description: Cape Fear Community College will welcome CFCC alumnus S.C. Porter, author, poet, and small-business owner, for An Evening S.C. Porter on Wednesday, February 25th. The event will go from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. at the Union Station Auditorium on the Downtown Campus. The event is free, and open to students, faculty, staff and community members.

item.title: 25th annual St. Patrick’s Day Parade set to return to downtown Wilmington
item.description: The Wilmington St. Patrick's Day Parade Committee announces the 25th Downtown Wilmington St. Patrick's Day Parade steps off at Front and Brunswick Streets at 11:00 a.m. on Saturday, March 14th in historic downtown Wilmington.

item.title: Scientific studies calculate climate change as health danger, while Trump calls it a ‘scam’
item.description: The Trump administration on Thursday revoked a scientific finding that climate change is a danger to public health, an idea that President Donald Trump called “a scam.” But repeated scientific studies say it’s a documented and quantifiable harm.

item.title: UNCW takes down Elon 65-54
item.description: The UNCW men's basketball game picked up a home win for the first time in 26 days after knocking off Elon 65-54 on Thursday.

item.title: Southport Board of Aldermen opposes Interbasin Transfer Certificate from the Town of Fuquay-Varina
item.description: In a regular Southport Board of Aldermen meeting, city leaders talk about opposing the ITB certificate from the town of Fuquay Varina, and several other talking points.
